name: Discipline
summary: Executor Zygand turns to outsiders in Tirisfal Glades to keep his Deathguard sentries alert. He has little faith in the garrison and orders physical punishment for those who slacken.

sections.title: Enforcing Order in Undeath
sections.body: The Deathguard guard the Forsaken across Lordaeron. Freedom from the Lich King's control has brought its own troubles: apathy, fatigue, and neglect. Executor Zygand has little patience for sentries who let their discipline slip. The Scarlet Crusade and Scourge prowl Tirisfal's borders, and the garrison must stay ready. Its officers use force and close oversight to keep the troops alert.

sections.title: The Executor's Ledger
sections.body: Executor Zygand chooses outsiders to punish negligent Deathguards instead of using soldiers from his own garrison. With the Executor's Motivator, you remind sentries that service to the Dark Lady demands constant vigilance. Even in undeath, they cannot escape the consequences of neglecting their duties.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand gives the order in Tirisfal Glades, where he oversees the region's defenses and demands obedience from his troops.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want the Deathguard punished?
faq.answer: Zygand considers his Deathguards incompetent and lacking drive. He believes their complacency endangers the Forsaken in Tirisfal, so he uses harsh punishment to rouse the sentries.

faq.q: Why does Zygand use an adventurer instead of another soldier?
faq.answer: Zygand says you have not yet joined the Deathguard, so you have not had the chance to disappoint him.
The Executor's Motivator is a disciplinary tool Zygand gives you to punish idle Deathguards stationed across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What happens if you refuse Zygand's order?
faq.answer: Zygand warns that if you hesitate or refuse, he will enter your name in his ledger and send someone else to discipline you.

faq.q: How do the Forsaken view pain?
faq.answer: Zygand counts pain among the few pleasures still open to him in death. His delight in punishment reflects his harsh nature.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, discipline means survival. Sentries who give in to apathy put all of Tirisfal Glades at risk.
Forsaken commanders use grim methods, reflecting the harsh rule of the Horde's northern lands.
